# trees

> One Intent UI (IAP v0.1) document rendered live by six catalog-agnostic UI trees: Kumo, terminal TUI, System 7, Swiss print, LCARS and shadcn.

- Live: https://trees.customer0.dev
- Source: https://github.com/acoyfellow/trees
- Based on: https://intent-ui.com (RFC: https://intent-ui.com/rfc) by Brayden Wilmoth

## What it shows

- A single IAP document (pages, sources, blocks, intents) is the source of truth; each UI tree is a host binding over the same component types.
- Clicking a row or button with an unbuilt intent "materializes" a page into the document once (simulated model call, version bump).
- Switching UI trees, or opening two side by side, replays the materialized page with zero model calls.
- The JSON inspector shows the document as it changes.

## Caveats

- Model calls are simulated; there is no LLM behind it. Data is a fixed fixture.
- Renderers are hand-written CSS themes over one component set, not separate component libraries.
